title: nagori snap (v1)
description: Schema defining a 'snap'—a raw thought fragment. Binary packing rule: [v: 2B][t: 4B][w_len: 1B][w_data][n_len: 1B][n_data][p_len: 1B][p_data][b_len: 1B][b_data][s_len: 1B][s_data]. Max ~299 bytes total.

v.description: Protocol Version identifier (Packed: 2 bytes ASCII string 'n1')

t.description: Unix timestamp in seconds (Packed: 4 bytes uint32 big-endian)

w.description: Subjective time / context expression (Packed: 1 byte length + UTF-8 string, max 45 bytes)

n.description: Temporary mask/alias name (Packed: 1 byte length + UTF-8 string, max 45 bytes)

p.description: Preamble / Preface context (Packed: 1 byte length + UTF-8 string, max 60 bytes)

b.description: Main body text of the thought fragment (Packed: 1 byte length + UTF-8 string, max 108 bytes)

s.description: Postscript / Sign-off tag (Packed: 1 byte length + UTF-8 string, max 30 bytes)
